Only two of the three fixes are likely correct, so the score is 0.5.

The subscriptions empty state fix is equivalent: it stacks the layout in a narrow container. The Back link fix is plausible, since it resolves the short id via an API call and falls back to a list, but it reaches the outcome differently from upstream and adds risk. The duplicate fix targets a different sidebar logic (scene panel) than upstream's side panel modal mode, so it may not close the panel that covers the copy.

The Back link fix is different but should work. The agent resolves the short id asynchronously through an API call in resourceTransferLogic. Upstream passes the short id in the URL query string. The agent's fallback is the saved insights list, which matches upstream's fallback in intent. The subscriptions empty state now stacks in a narrow container, using a card-level container query instead of the existing named modal container. That is acceptable. The sidebar-close fix targets a different logic than upstream. It closes the scene panel, not the side panel in modal mode. That makes it uncertain whether the reported bug is fixed, so the patch is only partly right.

results.evidence: The patch calls `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` unconditionally when redirectToInsight, with no check of overlay/narrow presentation. It does close the panel on narrow screens, but it also closes it on wide screens. Whether the criterion is met depends on the reading: the overlay case is covered (closed), so strictly c1 is satisfied in behaviour; however, I can't see that setScenePanelOpen exists on sceneLayoutLogic.
`lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` is still called, and `router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` still follows the panel close inside `if (redirectToInsight)`.
The close is unconditional: `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` with no check for overlay/modal presentation, so a docked wide-screen panel is closed too.
The navigation to the transfer page is unchanged; the short id is not carried in the URL. Instead the transfer logic fetches it via `insightsApi.getByNumericId` on mount.

`return sourceInsightShortId ? urls.insightView(sourceInsightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()` — Back resolves to the short-id view URL once resolved (via an API lookup rather than a URL param, which is an acceptable design for the resulting behaviour).
When sourceInsightShortId is null (unavailable), sourceResourceUrl returns `urls.savedInsights()`, the insights list.
Dashboard and Survey cases still return `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `urls.survey(resourceId)`; no URL parameters were added for other kinds, and the loader returns null for non-Insight kinds.

`<LemonCard ... className="p-6 @container">` with `<div className="flex flex-col @md:flex-row gap-3 items-start">` stacks vertically below the container's md width and puts the illustration beside the text at wider widths.
